$comment: Stackra file contract — Purpose: the mobile app's shared strings: states, the offline banner, consent, the order card menu, push channels, OS usage strings, enum labels and refusal texts (namespace `mobile::`, locale `ar`). Boundary: same keys in every base locale (gen fails otherwise); every Arabic plural carries all six CLDR categories (zero, one, two, few, many, other) or gen fails. Derived keys sit under their kind segment and are never authored elsewhere: `enums.<enum>.<code>`, `errors.<code>.message`; every other key is authored. A regional overlay (`en-US`, `ar-SA`) holds only the keys whose wording differs there. Strings of another module are overrides under src/overrides/<owner>/, never here. Runtime: react-native. Governing contract: ADR 0294 (decision 20), ADR 0192, ADR 0234, ADR 0080
